name: MessageBird
label: MessageBird — Bird SMS API
description: Bird (formerly MessageBird) via the current regional platform API. Base https://{platform_host} (default us1.platform.bird.com). Docs: https://bird.com/en-us/docs/guides/sms/sending-sms and https://bird.com/en-us/docs/guides/authentication. Auth: Bearer bk_{region}_… key (config key access_key kept). Send is POST /v1/sms/messages with to, from, text, category. Legacy rest.messagebird.com + AccessKey / originator / body / recipients / GET /balance are retired — see README. Sender-ID and category rules vary by country. listen = status/inbound as BPMN message events. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One MessageBird operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"send-sms"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-sms | listen. get-balance was removed (no SMS-key balance on platform.bird.com). listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: to
schema.description: Destinations E.164 for send-sms. Official to. Example: ["+15551234567"].

schema.label: from
schema.description: Originator for send-sms. Official from. Also config default.

schema.label: text
schema.description: SMS body for send-sms. Official text.

schema.label: category
schema.description: SMS category. Typical: transactional | promotional. Also config.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-sms, listen. get-balance was removed (no SMS-key wallet read on platform.bird.com). listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: Bird API key
configurationParameters.description: Current Bird workspace key (bk_us1_… or bk_eu1_…). Header Authorization: Bearer. Config shortCode access_key is unchanged so existing secrets keep working. Legacy AccessKey values for rest.messagebird.com will 401. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: from (sender)
configurationParameters.description: Default sender when input omits from. E.164, short code, or alphanumeric sender ID. Current Bird SMS field (replaces originator).

configurationParameters.label: SMS category
configurationParameters.description: Default category when input omits category. Required on a free-text send. EXACT examples: transactional | marketing | authentication.

configurationParameters.label: Platform host
configurationParameters.description: Regional Bird host without scheme. Must match the key prefix: bk_us1_ → us1.platform.bird.com; bk_eu1_ → eu1.platform.bird.com. Wrong region returns 421.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
